entities.summary: Jamila Bio Ibrahim is a Nigerian medical doctor, development specialist and politician, who formerly served as Nigeria's Minister of Youth. She was known for her advocacy of the UN SDGs and her role as former Minister of Youth. She was appointed to the position by President Bola Tinubu in September 2023. Prior to her appointment, she served as the president of the Progressive Young Women Forum (PYWF). She has also served as the Senior Special Assistant to the Kwara State Governor on Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
